批发订购Wholesale orders

统一的商业起订政策One commercial order policy

最低订购量（MOQ）：7,500 升橄榄油。支持 250 毫升、500 毫升和 750 毫升混合订购。具体装柜方案以最终确认为准。Minimum order quantity (MOQ): 7,500 litres of olive oil per order. Mixed 250 ml, 500 ml and 750 ml bottle sizes available. Loading plan subject to confirmation.

该最低量适用于每笔订单的橄榄油总容量，并不构成对集装箱装载能力的保证。The minimum applies to the total olive-oil volume per order and is not a guarantee of container capacity.

Morocco

摩洛哥产地Moroccan origin

从橄榄园到可追溯批次From olive groves to traceable lots

GANLAN GOLD 协调 Fouad 的农业经营与经筛选的周边橄榄种植者，通过明确的采购、批次追踪和质量控制准备流程，传递摩洛哥橄榄种植传统。GANLAN GOLD coordinates Fouad’s agricultural operation with selected neighboring olive growers through defined sourcing, lot traceability and quality-control preparation, grounded in Morocco’s olive-growing heritage.

交货规则Incoterms

具体 Incoterm 须在报价中确认。若约定 FOB，交货义务为在指定摩洛哥港口将货物装上船；集装箱货物交付码头时，应与货运代理评估 FCA 是否更适用。The applicable Incoterm is confirmed in the quotation. Under FOB, delivery is completed when goods are loaded on board at the named Moroccan port. For container cargo handed to a terminal, FCA should be considered with the freight forwarder.

价格不包含Exclusions

所示出口价格不包含国际运费、适用的国际运输保险、中国清关、关税及进口税费，也不包含运送至中国买方仓库。Indicated export prices exclude international freight, applicable international transport insurance, Chinese customs clearance, duties and import taxes. Delivery to the buyer’s warehouse in China is not included.

商业文件Documents

经确认可取得并适用时，商业文件可包括商业发票、装箱单、原产地证书、质量控制文件以及适用的出口和海关文件。Where confirmed available and applicable, commercial documentation may include the commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, quality-control documentation and applicable export/customs documents.
